question: When is production expected to begin in J M Smucker's (NYSE: SJ) new distribution center in McCalla, Alabama?
model_answer:
Smucker said production at the McCalla facility would begin in calendar year 2025. The company announced in November 2021 that construction would begin no later than January 2022, with production commencing in calendar year 2025. The site is a $1.1 billion manufacturing and distribution center for Uncrustables sandwiches. Its fiscal 2024 annual report repeated that timing, saying production is expected to begin at the McCalla facility during 2025.

The plant opened sooner than that. On Nov. 7, 2024, Smucker celebrated the opening of the McCalla facility, which will support Uncrustables production. I didn't find a source giving the exact date production actually started.
judge_reason: States production expected to begin in 2025, matching the official answer; the extra Nov. 2024 opening claim does not contradict that expectation.
